Functionally equivalent for this BG; future BG should either extend the hook to add a --stage-dir mode or rename the spec step.

Wrapper hexa run vs raw hf CLI deviation: ubu1 hexa_real binary differs from mac in args() shape (ubu1 keeps 'run' + script_path in argv[1..2]; mac elides them, putting flags at argv[2..]). hexa run tool/hf_upload_mk2.hexa --upload fails on ubu1 with 'unknown command: tool/hf_upload_mk2.hexa'. L1 naming + readme validators ran successfully on mac. Actual upload step bypassed the hexa wrapper and called /home/aiden/venv_orchestrator/bin/hf upload directly (hf CLI 1.13.0; same network call the wrapper would have made internally). Audit JSONL was written manually mirroring _audit_write() shape. Spec carve-out raw#9 (md+json — bash for upload OK, no .py edits) explicitly authorizes this. Future fix: patch tool/hf_upload_mk2.hexa main() to detect both argv shapes (or pin ubu1 hexa_real to a binary build matching mac).
